description: Closed-loop execution feedback — the chain of record: PROPOSAL → DECISION → COMMITMENT (PO) → RECEIPT. Reconciliation of transfer plans against ingested goods-in/out (RECONCILED | MISMATCH), lead-time learning, supplier scorecards, realized savings, double-order guard. Ported verbatim; golden-guarded. Version 1.1.0 adds the M6 receipt→PO-line matching layer (build spec §14.6b; gate 16; named proof feedback/matching): split, amended, cancelled and returned lines, FIFO merge allocation disclosed, over-receipt tolerance, the honesty rules, and the refusal family — composing reconcileProposal as the per-line leaf, no forked formulas. Version 1.2.0 adds the loop's second turn (build spec §14.6d; audit M4 scorecards; named proof feedback/scorecard-matching-fed): supplierScorecards composes the unchanged M2 H2 scorecard engine over the matching layer's result — attribution follows the line's actual supplier, UNSOLICITED lines are evidence with their own line-fact reconciliation, cancelled evidence is disclosed not vanished, the flag rollup rides additively, and unattributed evidence is a named surface, never a guess. Version 1.3.0 adds the loop's learning turn (build spec §14.6e; audit M3 efficacy; named proof feedback/efficacy-matching-fed): efficacySignals composes the unchanged M3/M2/lead-time engines over the matching layer's per-proposal aggregates — the proposal is the unit of judgment (a split commitment is one judgment, never manufactured sample size), the observation join is inventory's and strict (booleans only; observed/unobserved disclosed; missing observation ≠ clean outcome), CANCELLED proposals are disclosed and UNSOLICITED deliveries never judged, recall rides the same join (unmatched-ref stockouts are the missedShortages dangerous class), the portfolio lead time rides observed reality, aggregate flags are deduped at the source, and unmatched observations are a named surface.
